The player's Geomancer staff's 'Resonance Pulse' — a low-frequency vibration ability — disrupts its internal harmonic lattice. If the player does not use Resonance Pulse, the Golem regenerates 10 HP per second until destroyed.

The player must use the upgraded Resonance Pulse (from the Echo-Resonance Shard) to hit the three floating platforms simultaneously. When struck, they emit a harmonic pulse that destabilizes the Warden's phase-shifting field — exposing its core for 5 seconds. Without the Shard upgrade, the Warden is invulnerable.

The player must use the Harmonic Frequency Beacon (from prior encounter) to attune the boss chamber's ambient frequency. While attuned, the Sentinel's armor fractures and becomes vulnerable to standard Geomancer melee strikes. Without the Beacon, the Sentinel regenerates 20 HP/sec and reflects 80% of ranged damage.
